name: hatebookkeeping
description: Bookkeeping for Axilogy and Naton Lab: quotes, invoices, expenses, claims, salary and the monthly P&L

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @hbk/server && npm run build --workspace @hbk/web
scripts.build:shared: npm run build --workspace @hbk/shared && npm run build --workspace @naton/ui
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,ui,server,web -c blue,cyan,green,magenta "npm:dev:shared" "npm:dev:ui" "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.dev:local: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,web -c green,magenta "npm run dev:local --workspace @hbk/server" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @hbk/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @hbk/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm test --workspace @hbk/shared && npm test --workspace @hbk/server
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
